prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single architectural line-art plate for the Chinese heritage collection 访古. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the delicate fine black outlines, organic confidence and generous empty white areas of the Vairocana drawing. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: the complete front of Tian Kuang Hall (天贶殿), Dai Temple in Tai'an, Shandong, NOT Dacheng Hall at Qufu and NOT the Forbidden City. Preserve this very wide, low nine-bay facade with ten plain round front columns, two broad hipped roof eaves, low upper wall between eaves, gently rising roof corners, central vertical plaque shape, lattice doors, platform and steps. The ridge ends and roof shapes must follow the actual photograph. Show the main hall only; remove the two foreground side pavilions, large central incense burner, tourists, lanterns, signage, modern barriers, sky and all writing. Do not add sculpted dragon columns (this hall has plain round columns). Do not invent an extra storey or third roof. Draw an upright near-orthographic frontal elevation, complete ridge ornaments, side eaves and base inside the canvas. Landscape 1536x1024; architecture about 85% of width with clear white margins. Use very thin black contour lines on pure white. All surfaces, doors and roof planes remain white; a few finer lines suggest brackets, lattice and roof structure without rendering every tile. No black fill, no gray shading, no hatching, no color, no texture, no shadows, no labels or captions or frame or watermark. Sparse line density consistent with the style reference; fine outlines will later be tinted to the website's Ming-Qing blue palette and white made transparent.

site_recommendation.name: 岱庙
site_recommendation.year_note: 1677为碑记所载康熙朝岱庙重修告成年，作为现存清式形制的约略排序依据；以后仍经修缮，不将全体现存构件定为同年。
site_recommendation.lede: 泰山脚下，天贶殿以两重宽檐展开祭岳礼制的尺度。从宋代创建到清代重修，梁架、门窗与壁画叠合着不同年代的记忆。
facts: 天贶殿是岱庙主殿，供奉泰山神，宋代创建后历经修葺。
大殿面阔九间、进深五间，重檐庑殿顶，上覆黄琉璃瓦。
现存木构架的尺度与构件做法体现清代特征，殿内壁画清初重绘。
康熙碑记载1677年重修告成，大殿保留可用梁柱并更换损坏构件；年表据此作约略定位，后世修缮另计。

verification: 已查看实照与生成：九间十柱、两重庑殿宽檐、素圆柱与台基完整；无前景小亭、香炉、游人、灯笼及文字，黑线白底，整体横阔比例保留。
